The path consists of three points: (14.44,11.99), (76.77,22.48), and (40.71,55.25).  
The "M" command moves to the first point, then "L" draws lines to the second and third points.  
The final "M" is actually a "Z" equivalent in effect because it closes the path by drawing from the third point back to the first point.  
Thus, the path draws a closed shape with three vertices — a triangle.  

Final answer: (J)
